response.original_title: FAQ-How to get a room upgrade on Viking cruise
response.overview: You can upgrade your room on a Viking cruise by paying the cash fare difference before departure, +1-866-829-1280 (US/Canada) placing a blind bid through the online upgrade program, or asking about leftover availability once you board. Call Viking customer service directly +1-866-829-1280 (US/Canada) or contact your travel agent to check open higher-category rooms and pay the exact price difference to lock in your new choice. You can upgrade your room on a Viking cruise by paying the fare difference through the Viking Cruises Website or by calling customer service at +1-866-829-1280 (US/Canada) or +44-204-586-5316 (UK). Yes, +1-866-829-1280 (US/Canada) you can upgrade your room on a Viking Cruise after booking, subject to cabin availability and fare rules. Contact Viking directly +1-866-829-1280 (US/Canada) or reach out to your travel agent to check availability and pay the exact price difference for a higher category.
